**What's the use case?**
What are you trying to do that the framework doesn't support today?

**Proposed change**
A description of the change you're proposing.

**Theoretical grounding (if applicable)**
If this touches one of the consciousness theories in `CLAUDE.md` (GWT, GNWT,
IIT, HOT, RPT, PP/FEP, AST, CTM), note which computational commitments it
advances, and which of the 14 Butlin et al. indicators in `INDICATORS.md` it
affects.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you considered and why you didn't pick them.
